title: Felt host imports: native game state access for WASM extensions
description: Implement ~30 WASM import functions in the Baize server (wasmtime Linker) that provide direct native access to GameState structs. Felt extensions call these instead of parsing JSON. Imports cover: zone access (by name/index, type, dimensions, cell/component counts), cell access (by index, by coords, occupant), component properties (type, owner, rank, suit, id, arbitrary property), player access, state metadata (turn, phase, counters, finished), grid adjacency (adjacent/diagonal cell enumeration, bounds check). All use i32 opaque handles with -1 for null. String-returning imports write to caller buffer and return length. ~100 lines of Rust registering functions with wasmtime Linker. See FELT.md 'Layer 1: Host Imports' for complete import list.
close_reason: felt_host.rs compiles and passes tests with wasmtime 45. Registers ~30 host imports (zone/cell/component/player/game-state access) with wasmtime Linker<HostState>. HostState built from GameState with handle tables.
